functions.name: spot_can_view_content
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.spot_can_view_content(target uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select exists(select 1 from public.profiles p where p.id=target and p.is_active and
 (not p.is_private or p.id=(select auth.uid()) or
 (exists(select 1 from public.profiles me where me.id=(select auth.uid()) and me.is_active) and
 exists(select 1 from public.social_follows f where f.followed_id=target and f.follower_id=(select auth.uid())))));
$function$

functions.name: spot_follow_identity
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.spot_follow_identity()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
 if new.follower_id<>old.follower_id or new.followed_id<>old.followed_id then raise exception 'Follow identity is immutable'; end if;
 return new;
end $function$

functions.name: spot_guard_privacy
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.spot_guard_privacy()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
 if new.is_private is distinct from old.is_private and coalesce(auth.jwt()->>'role','')<>'service_role' then raise exception 'Use privacy settings endpoint'; end if;
 return new;
end $function$
